findings.issue: The ERRMSG obligations were under-split into only two facets (p9.error-errmsg-assigned, p9.no-error-errmsg-unchanged). The source sentence carries separately reviewable obligations: an explanatory message is assigned, the assignment has intrinsic-assignment semantics, and on success both the definition status AND the value are unchanged. The plan also omitted the initially-undefined definition-status branch entirely by planning only a defined sentinel success case.
findings.precedent: Compound-obligation precedent (C1161): a compound sentence can carry more than one obligation. The 9.7.5 ERRMSG model was required to be mirrored rather than a fresh decomposition invented.

pre_existing_fixture_check.why: Batch113 was blocked because it registered numbered rules that already had legacy fixture files. Registering such a rule STRUCTURALLY FORCES binding them, because validate_case_requirement runs once a rule is catalogued and rejects an empty facet list. A source packet must never bind fixtures.
pre_existing_fixture_check.result: No pre-existing cases under tests/ for any identifier. Registering them is therefore safe and nothing needed deferral.

attribution_table_audited.status: The reviewer audited the author's attribution table against the source rather than accepting it.
attribution_table_audited.verdict: All 12 diagnostic facets are filed under syntax or constraint units that actually prohibit the invalid property, including C1176 (default integer kind) and the NOTIFY_TYPE / coindexed facets under R1167, C1177 and C1178.
attribution_table_audited.principle: A facet may carry a diagnostic expectation only if the unit it is filed under actually prohibits something, only if a conforming processor is REQUIRED to reject, and only if a single-image program can portably observe the violation.

errmsg_discipline.rule: ERRMSG content is unspecified by the standard, so no oracle may compare its text in any form - not equality, not inequality against a sentinel, not a substring, not wording, not compiler agreement.
errmsg_discipline.applied_here: The two error-branch ERRMSG facets are source-classification only. Only the no-error unchanged-value facet has real oracle potential, and its plan must assert LEN explicitly because character comparison blank-pads the shorter operand.
errmsg_discipline.reviewer_verification: Confirmed that no ERRMSG text oracle was introduced anywhere in the packet.

multi_image_scope.statement: 11.5 FAIL IMAGE and much of 11.6 NOTIFY WAIT are multi-image material. This suite has no multi-image capability.
multi_image_scope.precedent: Batch112: a facet may carry a diagnostic expectation only if a processor is required to reject, and an executable oracle only if a single-image program can portably observe the effect. A dynamic multi-image synchronization obligation satisfies neither.
multi_image_scope.both_directions_checked: The reviewer was explicitly required to report over-suppression as readily as under-suppression, on the standing principle that an unobservability claim that is too broad is itself a defect. No over-suppression was found in this packet.
multi_image_scope.stat_discipline: A STAT oracle may assert only portable properties - positive, and distinct from the named STAT_FAILED_IMAGE and STAT_STOPPED_IMAGE values. The exact positive value is processor dependent and is recorded as latitude, never as a requirement.

permissions_recorded: 11.6 p4: the notify count after an error condition is processor dependent.
11.6 p7: the exact positive STAT error value is processor dependent; only positivity and distinctness from the named values are required.
11.6 p10: the set of possible NOTIFY WAIT error conditions is processor dependent.
11.4: the pre-existing STOP/ERROR STOP status and output items remain recommendations or processor-dependent availability, not requirements.
explicit_limitations: This is source accounting only. No fixture was bound, no case was added, no compiler was invoked and no runtime credit is claimed.
All 64 new facets remain pending. Registering a requirement is not evidence that any processor implements it.
FAIL IMAGE and NOTIFY WAIT effects are multi-image gated and are not observable by this suite in its current single-image regime.
NOTIFY WAIT error conditions and exact STAT values are processor dependent and are not portable oracles.

The branch-target facets that 11.2 unblocks are NOT discharged by this packet; they remain pending against their owning catalogues and require a dedicated migration batch with independent fixture review.
Future branch tests may observe only which statement executes next, not any claim about how the transfer is implemented.

fixture_state_discrepancy_adjudicated.verified_by: The integrator measured 1821 directly on main and inside the reporting author's own worktree; the batch124 reviewer independently identified the two orphaned records by name.
fixture_state_discrepancy_adjudicated.outcome: 1821 is the correct audit-active figure. The reviewer who argued for 1823 was overruled on that evidence. No defect exists and no records changed.
